name: Banshee

generation.prompt: A haunting cinematic portrait of a Banshee, a spectral Fey figure draped in flowing, tattered ethereal robes of silver and charcoal grey. She stands atop a jagged, mist-shrouded moor under a heavy, bruised purple twilight sky. Her expression is one of profound grief, mouth open in a silent, piercing wail, with ghostly translucent skin and long, floating white hair that blends into the swirling fog. Pale, moonlight illumination highlights the iridescent shimmer of her form, creating a mood of atmospheric dread and supernatural melancholy. Wide shot, deep depth of field, gothic fantasy aesthetic.

gmNotes: A Banshee is a medical researcher/scanner role — not a biological species. A typical Banshee is Fey and also carries the Medical Researcher (profession) archetype. The folk stories describe a wailing omen; the underlying function is research and scanning. Do not reveal the scanner function in player-facing description unless the fiction earns it.
description: A voice on the wind that some say foretells death — a wail heard in the hills before the news arrives. In the village, hearing a banshee is an omen, and no two people agree on what it means.
